CFML Language Reference: Functions

HTMLCodeFormat

Returns a string with the characters <, >, & and " replaced by their HTML entities, carriage returns removed, and the whole thing wrapped in <PRE> and </PRE>. Use it to show source code or other preformatted text exactly as typed.

Category

Display and formatting functions

Syntax

HTMLCodeFormat(string [, version ])

Parameters

string
The text to escape.
version
Optional. The HTML version to target: "-1", "2.0" or "3.2". Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion always uses the same set of entities.

Returns

The escaped string, surrounded by <PRE> tags.

Usage

Line breaks and spaces are kept because of the PRE block, which makes this the natural choice for displaying a file read with CFFILE. If you do not want the PRE tags, use HTMLEditFormat.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Source = "<TABLE BORDER=1>" & Chr(13) & Chr(10)
    & "  <TR><TD>Hello & welcome</TD></TR>" & Chr(13) & Chr(10)
    & "</TABLE>">
<P>The HTML source:</P>
<CFOUTPUT>#HTMLCodeFormat(Source)#</CFOUTPUT>
<P>The same HTML, rendered:</P>
<CFOUTPUT>#Source#</CFOUTPUT>

See also

HTMLEditFormat, ParagraphFormat, XMLFormat, JSStringFormat
